name: tree-with-lazy-loading
description: Wires MatTree to a flat data source that fetches a node's children only on first expand, tracking a per-node loading flag until they arrive — the standard pattern for a tree backed by an API that can't return the whole hierarchy up front.
templateCode: {{ node.name }} {{ node.name }} Loading...
notes: toggle() only fetches children the first time a node is expanded — subsequent toggles reuse the cached entry in childrenByParentId, so a node's remote children are fetched at most once per component instance.

Reassigning dataSource.data (even to the same reference) is what tells MatTreeFlatDataSource to re-run the flattener and re-render — mutating childrenByParentId alone, without that reassignment, leaves the tree showing stale (empty) children after the fetch resolves.

hasChild is bound to *matTreeNodeDef's `when` clause, so it must stay in sync with expandable on every node — a node marked expandable: true with no children ever fetched renders an expand toggle that opens onto nothing.
